events.symptom: Graph search reconstructs innerHTML on every input event, discarding keyboard focus and cursor continuity.
events.acceptance: Typing successive characters keeps the search field focused, preserves selection and filters matching nodes.

events.symptom: Click or Enter on a graph node replaces its DOM without restoring focus, interrupting keyboard exploration.
events.acceptance: Selecting a node by keyboard retains visible focus on the selected node after graph rerender.

events.symptom: Git status and repository evidence availability are shown as technical fragments, while node freshness and authority are not clearly distinguished in the graph hierarchy.
events.acceptance: A prominent graph scope summary accurately differentiates unverified Git, no repository claims, fresh, stale and unchecked states; inspector separates evidence authority from Git verification.

events.symptom: Graph meta text is 9.5px, origin labels 8px, and graph relationship metadata 9px, creating difficult reading at normal zoom.
events.acceptance: Graph context, node relationship labels and essential metadata use a readable type scale without obscuring the primary graph.

events.symptom: Body min-width 860px and graph min-width 560px plus inspector min-width 300px force narrow-window clipping rather than responsive transposition.
events.acceptance: At 760px and 390px viewport widths all primary graph controls, graph canvas and inspector remain accessible without horizontal viewport scrolling.

events.symptom: Raw authority classes and inferred/typed relation origins need domain-accurate explanatory labels and separation from proof claims.
events.acceptance: The graph clearly describes how canonical, advisory typed and optional similarity edges differ, and never equates agent-derived inference with verified Git provenance.

events.reason: Search focus and caret restoration implemented and source-tested; uninterrupted keyboard interaction needs browser confirmation.
Selected-node SVG focus restoration implemented and checked at source level; assistive technology interaction needs browser confirmation.
Pure presentation helper tests cover missing, fresh, stale, unchecked and unbound Git; prominent placement needs rendered evaluation.
Typography was raised in CSS, but actual contrast and readability at normal zoom were not measured in a browser.
Responsive transposition rules are present; no rendered 390px/760px viewport or overflow screenshot has been verified.
Authority and Git freshness have separate semantic labels and inspector blocks; visual distinction has not been inspected in a browser.

events.symptom: Graph node labels show opaque @hex references instead of the meaning of each memory; screenshot at 390px and 760px requires opening the inspector to identify nodes.
events.acceptance: For <=24 visible nodes the canvas displays readable claim-derived titles directly on each interactive node, with opaque refs only in disclosure/tooltip; no invented semantic claims.
events.evidenceRef: User-supplied Memory Console screenshots 2026-11-05: desktop, 760px and 390px; D12.1 user feedback.

events.symptom: Relation lines show no readable semantic label; screenshots cannot show what rejects or supersedes what.
events.acceptance: On selecting a node, recorded relation names are visible on its connected edges, and direction/from/to is inspectable without creating inferred relations.
events.evidenceRef: User-supplied Memory Console screenshots 2026-11-05: desktop, 760px and 390px; D12.1 user feedback.

events.symptom: At 390px the graph is scrollable but the full inspector remains permanently stacked after a large canvas.
events.acceptance: Small-screen graph displays canvas first and opens an accessible dismissible inspector only on explicit node selection; desktop inspector remains persistent.
events.evidenceRef: User-supplied Memory Console screenshots 2026-11-05: desktop, 760px and 390px; D12.1 user feedback.

events.symptom: At 390px the memories list and complete inspector are stacked continuously; selected memory creates a very long page and list loses focus.
events.acceptance: At mobile widths, memory details are hidden until a memory is selected and have a clear close/back action, preserving existing replace/forget gating.
events.evidenceRef: User-supplied Memory Console screenshots 2026-11-05: desktop, 760px and 390px; D12.1 user feedback.

events.symptom: Memories inspector displays empty pipeline fields ('n/a') and no-change lifecycle/conflict sections; primary record meaning gets lost.
events.acceptance: Prioritize record, state and source, suppress empty optional pipeline rows by default and keep advanced metadata accessible without fabricating values.
events.evidenceRef: User-supplied Memory Console screenshots 2026-11-05: desktop, 760px and 390px; D12.1 user feedback.

events.symptom: Narrow graph screenshot shows tiny text, disconnected visible node labels and overlong controls; 760px screenshot wastes space on vertical scroll and inspector.
events.acceptance: Graph uses readable node containers, selective relation labels, compact mobile legend and fit-for-purpose viewport sizes, with no horizontal PAGE overflow.
events.evidenceRef: User-supplied Memory Console screenshots 2026-11-05: desktop, 760px and 390px; D12.1 user feedback.
